I did quick review of ALL Rush studio albums in chronological order.
I think you need to switch Presto and Power Windows. Presto was just so boring, and Power Windows had amazing songs (my personal favorite being Marathon, one of my favorite Rush songs of all time).

Only 3 stars for Caress of Steel? I am disappoint, this was their early metal influenced phase. And they were like no others at the time.

Signals: One of my favorites. For those who love guitar solos, Alex Lifeson lays one helluva lick in the Analog Kid.

Moving Pictures: The only song I got tired of was Tom Sawyer, only because they played it to death on the radio. The rest of the album is total Rush immersion.

Just my 3 cents.

the first time i saw rush in concert was on the permanent waves tour and then again the next year on moving pictures. while i'm sure this has some influence on my favorite rush music i have never understood the love that signals gets. i know i'm an exception because a lot of my friends really like that album.

in my mind permanent waves/moving pictures/signals represent a trilogy of sorts. all three were more mainstream than previous albums and by the time signals came out i was kind of tired of that era. although i prefer hemispheres and 2112 i still really like permanent waves. i've heard a little too much moving pictures or more accurately although it's a good album i don't listen to it often having heard it so much. even so i still think it's a really good album in spite of over exposure.
Caress of Steel could be nearly 4/5. There is amazing songs there (Bastille Day) for sure, but also some moments where Rush are still woodshedding their craft as a progressive writers.
